Name: Sunberry Village
Author: skellady
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/4fbwe1n.png[/img]
[b][size=4][center]Sunberry Village: The [color=#e06666]R[/color][color=#f6b26b]a[/color][color=#ffd966]i[/color][color=#93c47d]n[/color][color=#6d9eeb]b[/color][color=#8e7cc3]o[/color][color=#c27ba0]w[/color] Ends at Sunberry[/center][/size][size=3]
[/size][/b][size=3]﻿﻿[center]Sunberry Village is an expansion mod created by skellady, sophiesalacia, and The Sunberry Team! Adds a new town to explore south of Pelican Town with new NPCs, custom maps, crops, trees, special orders, weapons, and more![/center][/size]


[center][img]https://imgur.com/s70QkN2.png[/img]﻿[/center][b]

[/b][center][size=5][b][/b][/size][/center][quote][center][color=#e69138][size=5][b]CHARACTERS:
[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]- 17 new NPCs
- Over 80 new events
- New stories and plotlines to uncover
- Seasonal outfits for some characters (more to come soon!)[/size][/center]
[size=3]
[/size][center][size=5][b][color=#e69138]SHOPS:
[/color][/b]
[/size][size=3]- Shop for flower seeds
- Convenience store + seeds and saplings
- Blacksmith and weaponsmith
- Clothing store
- Cat cafe

[/size][b][color=#e69138][size=5]QUESTS:
[/size][/color][/b]
[size=3]- New special order board 
- New museum to fill up
- New farm space to unlock
- Unlockable items and events when finishing orders[/size]

[b][color=#e69138][size=5]ITEMS:
[/size][/color][/b]
[size=3]- New drinks and food
- New fish
- New forage
- New crops
- New tree
- New weapons
- New minerals
- New artifacts
- New machines
- New artisan goods[/size]

[b][color=#e69138][size=5]COMBAT:
[/size][/color][/b]
[size=3]- New mines with multiple levels and different biomes to explore
- New monsters

[/size][/center][/quote][center][size=3][/size][/center]

[center]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/8WVeQGS.png[/img]


[size=3]Please read the installation guide [/size][b][url=https://github.com/skellady/Sunberry-Village/blob/main/Installation%20Guide.md]HERE[/url]﻿[/b][size=3]![/size]

[size=3]If you're reporting bugs, please include your [/size][b][url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/b][size=3] log! We can't help without a log.[/size]


[img]https://imgur.com/RRqrXWt.png[/img]

﻿
[size=3]A "[b]config.json[/b]" file will generate upon launching the game with Sunberry Village. You can either edit it manually or through Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM). This is a list explaining all the configuration options:[/size]

[b][color=#e69138][size=4][/size][/color][/b][quote]
[color=#e69138][size=4][b]FestivalPatches

[/b][/size][/color][size=3]Default: [b]true[/b]

Description: Enables/disables SBV's festival patches but keeps the NPCs where they are. Only disable if you run into a visual issue that annoys you. Switch to [b]false[/b] if you want to disable them.[/size]

[b][color=#e69138][size=4]BoardUnlock

[/size][/color][/b][size=3]Default: [b]Vanilla

[/b]Description: Toggles whether you want the Sunberry special order board to unlock with vanilla, or with reaching 4 hearts with Elias. Switch to [b]Elias[/b] if you don't want it to unlock with vanilla.

[b][color=#e69138][size=4]IncludeNPCsInPerfection

[/size][/color][/b][size=3]Default: [b]true

[/b]Description: Whether or not Sunberry Village NPCs count towards perfection. True by default. Set to false if you don't want them to count.
[/size][/size][/quote][/center][center][size=3][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://imgur.com/PmrgOam.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=3]Sunberry Village should be compatible with EVERYTHING, including [b][color=#e69138]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE), Ridgeside Village (RSV), East Scarp (ES), and Visit Mount Vapius (VMV)[/color][/b]. If you run into any issues, let us know!

[size=3]Sunberry Village also adds crossover content in the form of dialogue, events, schedules, etc. for a bunch of mods.[/size]

[/size][size=4]SUNBERRY VILLAGE DOES [b]NOT[/b] WORK ON MOBILE/ANDROID OR ANY GAME VERSION THAT ISN'T 1.6.15+[/size]



[img]https://imgur.com/7zQhQBK.png[/img]


[size=3]Here's a list of add-on NPCs you can add to Sunberry Village to achieve maximum content/enjoyment!﻿

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14286]Wren the Plumber[/url]﻿
[/size][size=4][/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32660]Ripley the Farmer[/url]﻿[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12000]Jonghyuk and Spanner[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32385]Rose and the Alchemist[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999]Always Raining in the Valley[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32689]Lani[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33615]Dao[/url]﻿

[img]https://imgur.com/ce9aRnT.png[/img]﻿
If you'd like to make a mod to alter or build onto Sunberry Village's art/dialogue/etc., please see the permissions below:

[b]- [color=#6aa84f]YOU CAN[/color][/b] make alternate portraits/sprites for the NPCs as long as it's a significant change/edit, rather than editing three pixels and posting. [b][color=#dd7e6b]YOU CAN'T[/color][/b] use AI generated images. [color=#dd7e6b][b]YOU CAN'T[/b][/color] change the skin tone/facial features of our characters of color. Please be respectful.
[b]-[/b] [b][color=#6aa84f]YOU CAN[/color][/b] make alternate art of our items/machines/etc.
[b]-[/b] [b][color=#6aa84f]YOU CAN[/color][/b] add onto/alter the dialogue of the NPCs, but the changes [b]MUST[/b] be approved by skellady or sophiesalacia first.
[b]-[/b][color=#6aa84f] [b]YOU CAN[/b][/color] make recolors of our tilesheets to fit your preferences (desaturated/darker/VPR inspired/etc.)
[b]- [color=#6aa84f]YOU CAN[/color][/b] make a translation of the mod as long as you [b]don't remove or change ANY aspect of our characters[/b] (Ex: erasing a character's sexuality/gender identity). [b][color=#dd7e6b]YOU CAN'T[/color][/b] use AI/ChatGPT to translate our mod. Either translate it yourself manually, or don't translate it at all.
[b]-[/b] [b][color=#dd7e6b]YOU CAN'T[/color][/b] make NSFW art or dialogue for the NPCs.
[b]- [color=#dd7e6b]YOU CAN'T[/color][/b] alter the existing story lines of the NPCs (Ex: making Diala or Derya romanceable).
[b]- [color=#dd7e6b]YOU CAN'T[/color][/b] make an NPC for Sunberry Village, unless it's for your own personal use. Please understand that this is a closed project for us and our friends. It's our little playground where we get to have fun and create :] Any new additions or NPCs will be sought out by the team. If you're looking to add your NPCs to an existing town/village, you can take a look at East Scarp and similar mods that accept applications.

If there's something else you'd like to do but can't find in this section, please contact [b]skellady[/b] or [b]sophiesalacia[/b] on Discord.
